Backend Validation

FastAPI validates vendor information before updating the database.

  • Duplicate Company Name validation (business rules).
  • Email Address uniqueness validation.
  • GST Number uniqueness validation.
  • PAN Number uniqueness validation.

  • Document validation and storage.
  • Audit information updated automatically.
